notes.title: FLASHOUT 3 now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans//42288247/d5bc1cecacf056cf0426c81cc909c9dd464bc0c2.gif[/img]

[h3]Hello all FLASHOUT fans![/h3]

We are delighted to inform, that the third and most explosive entry to the FLASHOUT franchise, [b]FLASHOUT 3, is now live on Steam! [/b]

That's right, and you can grab your copy 10% off! Don't miss this chance and join the competition! We hope you will enjoy the new game :).

[b]Thank you for your support![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761870

notes.title: Support of Steam Achievements added!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans//42288247/d5bc1cecacf056cf0426c81cc909c9dd464bc0c2.gif[/img]

[h3]Hello all FLASHOUT fans![/h3]

As you probably know, tomorrow we are releasing[b] FLASHOUT 3[/b], the most advanced and explosive addition to the [b]FLASHOUT[/b] series. Nevertheless it doesn't mean we forgot about our[b] FLASHOUT 3D:EE[/b] community, no Sirs![b] You requested, we delivered[/b] - yesterday we have uploaded an updated version of the game featuring [b]Steam Achievements[/b]. We hope this small addition will give you even more motivation to complete the game. Oh, and last but not least - don't forget to wishlist [b]FLASHOUT 3[/b] and to check it out when it launches tomorrow! [b]Thank you for your support![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761870
